S.SCHEDULE_ID AS ID, S.CONTENT_ID, CM.USER_ID, S.CREATED_BY, S.TITLE, S.SCHEDULE_TYPE, DATE_FORMAT(S.SCHEDULE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `DATE`, DATE_FORMAT(S.SCHEDULE_TIME, '%H:%i') AS `TIME`, S.CONTENT, S.LOCATION, S.STATUS, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CM.CREATED_AT) * 1000 AS CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CM.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 AS UPDATED_AT

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHEDULE (SCHEDULE_ID, CONTENT_ID, CREATED_BY, TITLE, SCHEDULE_TYPE, SCHEDULE_TIME, CONTENT, LOCATION, STATUS) VALUES (#{id}, #{contentId}, #{createdBy}, #{title}, #{scheduleType}, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{date}, ' ', #{time}), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), #{content}, #{location}, #{status})

S.TITLE = #{title}, S.SCHEDULE_TYPE = #{scheduleType}, S.CONTENT = #{content}, S.LOCATION = #{location}, S.STATUS = #{status},
S.SCHEDULE_TIME = STR_TO_DATE( CONCAT(COALESCE(#{date}, DATE_FORMAT(S.SCHEDULE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d')), ' ', COALESCE(#{time}, DATE_FORMAT(S.SCHEDULE_TIME, '%H:%i'))), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'),
WHERE S.SCHEDULE_ID = #{id} AND CM.USER_ID = #{userId} AND CM.IS_DELETED = 'N'
